_help: Test Your Product prices and tiers (US dollars only). deposit: share paid upfront (used only when a tier has no depositUsd). depositUsd: the exact deposit for a tier. popularLabel: the badge on the tier marked popular. guarantee: the line under the prices. foundingOffer: the founding banner; set left to how many slots are still open (the banner hides at 0, and the discounted deposits stop being sold), discount is the share taken off the deposit (0.4 = 40%). testerShare: share of the price paid out to testers, split between the testers whose work is approved. testerCoins: site coins (no cash value) for each approved test. minRank: the rank a player needs to become a tester (from data/ranks.json).
depositLine: Fully refunded if we decline your project after vetting.
